clue.text: Acerbity of English magistrate missing nothing

indicators.note: missing tells us a letter is dropped from the magistrate's title

parts.note: the doge was the chief magistrate of Venice or Genoa
nothing is zero, the round letter O

explanation.surface: A complaint about the sharp tongue of an English justice of the peace who has nothing to say.
explanation.walkthrough: The magistrate is the doge, elected ruler of Venice; 'missing' removes the nothing letter from his title.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharpness of tone, as in a voice with an edge to it, is acerbity.

clue.text: Gym period beset by noise coming from insect

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded by, so the noise word wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: a din is a loud noise
PT, physical training, is school gym
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A school gym lesson interrupted by a buzzing insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of the fly order Diptera, two-winged insects, are called by this name.

clue.text: Nasty looks from bully left surrounded by foreign police

indicators.note: surrounded by means the police letters go around the others

parts.note: the SS were the Nazi German police and paramilitary force
to cow someone is to bully or intimidate them

explanation.surface: Glares from a bully on the left, caught between officers of an overseas police force.
explanation.definitionFit: Frowns of displeasure or anger are nasty looks.

clue.text: Story about poet incorporating old material

parts.note: a fib is a small lie, a made-up story
re is the Latin-derived word for about, concerning

indicators.note: incorporating means taking in, so the poet word holds the old letter

parts.note: a bard is a poet

explanation.surface: A tale about a poet who works in antique fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Compressed wood-fibre board is a building material.

clue.text: The old man is embraced by a maiden in a movement defying social convention

parts.note: the old man is slang for father, dad

indicators.note: is embraced by means the word is sits inside the following letters

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: Father is hugged by a young woman who belongs to a rebellious movement.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'is' is part of the indicator; the second 'is' gives IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Dada was an early 20th-century art movement of deliberate absurdity, rejecting bourgeois norms.

clue.text: One's finished after queen has been grabbed?

definitions.text: One's finished after queen has been grabbed?

indicators.note: has been grabbed means the queen letter is seized and held within the other word

parts.note: done means finished
R, for Regina, is the abbreviation for queen

explanation.surface: Someone's life is over once the queen has been seized.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also defines: a male bee dies after mating with the queen.
explanation.definitionFit: A male honeybee mates with the queen and dies in the act, so it is finished once she is caught.

clue.text: What must pose explosive threat? Must not drunken male with glass?

indicators.note: drunken signals the letters of these words staggering into a new order

parts.note: he is a male pronoun
a lens is a piece of shaped glass

explanation.surface: A drunk man with a glass in his hand seems a menace that might erupt at any time.
explanation.definitionFit: The Washington volcano famously erupted in 1980, so it is a peak that poses an explosive threat.

clue.text: Rebuke youngster, learner lacking energy

indicators.note: lacking means the learner letter is taken away

parts.note: a child is a youngster
L is the abbreviation for learner, as on L-plates
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Telling off a child who is learning but has no get-up-and-go.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking' removes L from CHILD, leaving CHID.
explanation.definitionFit: To scold or reprove someone is to rebuke them.

clue.text: I, perfect in speech, may be one to be seen through

definitions.text: may be one to be seen through

indicators.note: in speech means what follows is heard, not seen written

parts.note: I is said like EYE and perfect means whole, said like HOLE

explanation.surface: Someone claiming to be flawless in their speaking manner, and perhaps transparent.
explanation.definitionFit: A peephole or opening in a mask is something one looks through.

clue.text: Strong wine taken after work's over

indicators.note: taken after places the wine following the work
over means turned over, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work; the 's joins it to over
tent is a deep red Spanish wine

explanation.surface: A potent wine drunk once the day's work is over.
explanation.definitionFit: Powerful or forceful, as with a potent drink.

clue.text: Cold wife, lacking firepower going about?

indicators.note: going about means surrounding the wife letter

parts.note: without weapons is unarmed

explanation.surface: A frigid spouse wandering around without a gun.
explanation.definitionFit: Not heated, so still cold.

clue.text: Goes through safe report that's been amended

indicators.note: amended means altered, so the letters are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: A security report that has been corrected is pierced.
explanation.definitionFit: To pierce or punch holes in something is to go through it.

clue.text: Sly act in restaurant perhaps that leaves others to clear up mess

definitions.text: that leaves others to clear up mess

parts.note: fly is British slang for sly or knowing
leaving a gratuity for a waiter, tipping, is an example of an act in a restaurant

explanation.surface: A sneaky move in an eatery that leaves the staff to clean up.
explanation.walkthrough: FLY-TIPPING is the British term for illegally dumping rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Dumping waste illegally leaves councils and neighbours to deal with the rubbish.

clue.text: Numbers possibly in reserve

definitions.meaning: Numbers is one of the ... of the Old Testament
to reserve a table or seat is to arrange it in advance

explanation.surface: Figures that may be kept back in store.
explanation.definitionFit: Numbers is a biblical volume, and to reserve is to arrange in advance.

clue.text: Deeply hate nob, horribly unacceptable in behaviour

indicators.note: horribly suggests the letters are badly mangled into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Loathing a toff intensely is shockingly bad manners.
explanation.walkthrough: A nob is British slang for an upper-class person.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes conduct outside the bounds of decency.

clue.text: Man tucked into fish, possible source of energy

indicators.note: tucked into means the island letters go inside the fish

parts.note: bass is a fish
IOM is the abbreviation for the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: A man eating a fish, which may give him energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is the Isle of Man, a British Crown dependency in the Irish Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Organic matter burnt as fuel can supply energy.

clue.text: Current is flooding area

indicators.note: flooding means the word is pours into the middle of the area word

parts.note: extent is area or scope

explanation.surface: A river current is inundating the region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' looks like flowing water; it means existing now.
explanation.definitionFit: Something presently existing or real is current.

clue.text: Times of relaxation not half evident in spring festival

indicators.note: not half means only the first half of the word is kept

parts.note: holidays are times of relaxation

explanation.surface: Breaks that are only half visible during a springtime celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hindu festival of colours is celebrated in spring.

clue.text: Any number in circle led by a member of tribe once?

indicators.note: led by means the article comes first
in means the number letter goes inside the circle

parts.note: a meridian is a great circle on the globe
N stands for any number in mathematics

explanation.surface: A vague number in a ring, headed by a tribesman of old.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of the Americas, a member of an indigenous people, in a now dated term.

clue.text: Soon, your setter's turning up as 'Giovanni'?

parts.note: anon is an old word for soon

indicators.note: turning up in a down clue means the letters are read upwards, in reverse

parts.note: the setter speaking of themselves would say my

explanation.surface: The setter soon appears under his pen name.
explanation.definitionFit: Giovanni is a pseudonym, an assumed name, which is what this word means.

clue.text: Article really nasty, not the last thing to come under the hammer

definitions.text: thing to come under the hammer

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: not the last means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: vile means really nasty

explanation.surface: A nasty item that will not be the final lot at auction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'under the hammer' suggests an auction; it is a blacksmith's block.
explanation.definitionFit: A smith's iron block is struck by the hammer.

clue.text: One sort of organ may get its sound from this

definitions.text: One sort of organ may get its sound from this

parts.words: One sort of organ may get its sound from this
parts.note: the organ is not a musical instrument but the ear, which gets sound from a headset device

explanation.surface: A church organ may get its sound from this.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organ' suggests the instrument; it is the ear.
explanation.definitionFit: A small speaker worn in or on the ear delivers sound to that organ.

clue.text: Loveless god, this person has to make strides

indicators.note: loveless means without love, the zero letter O

parts.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder
the setter saying this person has would say I've

explanation.surface: An unloved deity tells us I must press ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: To flourish or grow vigorously is to make strides.

clue.text: Enthusiasm beginning to recede with time

indicators.note: beginning to means only the first letter of the next word is used

parts.note: an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Keenness starts to wane as time goes by.
explanation.definitionFit: A craze or fashion, something all the rage, is a passion or enthusiasm.

clue.text: Boy that makes cheerful sound

indicators.note: sound means the word for cheerful is heard, not spelt

parts.note: sunny means cheerful

explanation.surface: A lad who is happy and noisy.
explanation.definitionFit: A familiar form of address for a young lad.

clue.text: Country uses security device, holding information back

indicators.note: holding means the security word grips the information inside it

parts.note: a seal on a package guarantees its security

indicators.note: back means the information word runs backwards

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: A nation uses a safety device to hold back intelligence.
explanation.definitionFit: A West African nation, so a country.
